reviews.title: Personal Notes
reviews.text:
This app is awesome, it’s constantly updated for users to have an easy experience on the app and has never let me down. It’s the only app I’ve ever used to track anything for my workouts and I did get the premium version that allows for even more in depth statistics of your training. 

The main thing I wanted to say in this review was that I think the developers of this app should maybe include a new feature that allows people who train others to have separate “notebooks” for different clients they may have. I say that because I love this app and I am currently finishing up NASM’s CPT course to become a personal trainer and I would absolutely love if this app could be what I record future clients workouts on. 

I think that would be an excellent addition to the app and it’s definitely something I’d pay a little extra for. I am no app developer and have absolutely no experience in building any form of software, but I know the dudes who made this app are goats and have had a lot of great ideas. If this ever gets read by someone I hope it may get taken into consideration because that would be legendary. I’m sure I’m not the only one who would say this. 

Good day to ya.

reviews.title: Great App
reviews.text: The free version of this app is all you need! Keeps track of your lifts so you know where you were on that lift your last session. It does what I was already doing in my Notes app only it’s much more organized. Love the built in timer so you can get right back to it after a quick rest. Decided to pay for the subscription on a Black Friday sale and I’m happy I did. I love that I can see my body weight decrease or my strength increases in graph form. Definitely nice to track over the long haul but even without these features, I’d still recommend the free version for anyone.
